fields.label: Google Play notes for this saved build
fields.requiredWhen: When the saved Android build needs its own notes, or no valid default exists. Every enabled Android locale needs valid effective notes.
fields.what: The public change summary for the exact saved Android build.
fields.why: Google Play uses this file instead of default notes whenever this build-specific file exists.
fields.where: Write the changes supplied by your release team. Save the release version first, then select a configured Android locale. You do not need to create a folder or filename.
fields.format: UTF-8; at most 500 Unicode characters including spaces and line endings (2000-byte read bound). Original bytes are kept.
fields.failure: An empty, invalid or unsafe exact-build note blocks release; a valid default does not hide it. Fix this note, then validate again.

fields.label: Default Google Play release notes
fields.requiredWhen: For a saved Android locale when its exact saved-build note is absent.
fields.what: Reusable public release copy used only when the current build has no exact note file.
fields.why: Lets releases reuse approved text without silently replacing existing build-specific notes.
fields.where: Write approved release copy, choose the saved Android locale, then review and Save here. The screen tells you if an exact note shadows this default.
fields.format: UTF-8; 500 Unicode characters including all whitespace. The application keeps your original bytes and handles the filename.
fields.failure: Saving a valid default cannot fix an invalid exact-build file. Use Notes for this saved build when the exact file needs correction. If an unused default file is present, full core metadata preflight still validates it; fix an invalid default even when an exact note is selected.

fields.label: Apple beta review notes
fields.requiredWhen: Required by enabled iOS metadata checks; later used for Apple beta review and external testing.
fields.what: Instructions for the Apple team reviewing your TestFlight beta, not the public App Store change log.
fields.why: Helps reviewers understand special setup or features they should exercise.
fields.where: Ask your release or QA team for reviewer instructions. Use the separate Apple review contact and demo-account credential fields for contact information and credentials.
fields.format: UTF-8 nonempty instructions. The current core has no field-specific character limit; this editor accepts at most 32 KiB. Local format-valid is not Apple acceptance.
fields.failure: Missing/placeholder instructions block metadata preparation. These are local repository text files, not protected credential storage; never include passwords or private keys.

fields.label: Apple App Review notes
fields.requiredWhen: Required by enabled iOS metadata checks; later used for App Store review.
fields.what: Instructions for the Apple team reviewing the production app. They are separate from beta review and public iOS release notes.
fields.why: Explains review setup, non-obvious features and how to exercise the app.
fields.where: Get production-review instructions from the release/QA team. Configure review contact and demo-account credentials separately in their dedicated fields.
fields.format: UTF-8 nonempty text; no field-specific character limit in the current core. The local editor cap is 32 KiB, not a promised Apple Store limit.
fields.failure: Missing or placeholder notes block metadata checks. Do not store credentials here: the notes are ordinary local repository text even though their Store audience is reviewers.

fields.label: TestFlight: what to test
fields.requiredWhen: Required by enabled iOS metadata checks; later used when configuring external TestFlight testing.
fields.what: Instructions describing what invited testers should try in this build.
fields.why: Tells testers which changes need feedback. The current toolkit uses the same fixed instructions for configured iOS locales.
fields.where: Ask your release/QA team for the test plan, then write or import a UTF-8 text file here. It is different from App Review notes and the public App Store change log.
fields.format: At most 4000 characters under the core preflight and Apple-bound trimming rules, and 64 KiB of original UTF-8 bytes. Fastlane sanitizes outbound text; Save keeps the original bytes.
fields.failure: Empty, oversized or placeholder instructions block the operation. Local validation does not contact TestFlight or prove provider acceptance.

actions.label: Load this required note
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Reads only the selected saved note and required configuration/version dependencies.
actions.why: Shows the saved starting text without a terminal or manual file copying.
actions.where: Select your project and the note kind; for Android also select a saved locale.
actions.format: Explicit local read; private note contents remain in this selected editor, not routine status/history.
actions.failure: A changed, unreadable, sensitive or unsafe input is refused. No read error is treated as a missing file.

actions.label: Check note format
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Checks this in-memory draft with the existing core note policy.
actions.why: Finds meaningful text/length/placeholder errors before a write or Store step.
actions.where: Write instructions or import a text file, then choose Check format.
actions.format: No files are changed and no Store is contacted. Format-valid is not release readiness.
actions.failure: Correct the reported field and check again. A changed draft makes an earlier result stale.

actions.label: Review the local file change
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Prepares an original-owner-bound before/after view without applying it.
actions.why: Lets you confirm exactly one note and any required missing directories before Save.
actions.where: Use Review change after a successful current draft validation.
actions.format: Binds the saved configuration, Android build/fallback state and original note. It cannot be reused for a different draft.
actions.failure: A stale or conflicting saved file/build requires a new Load and review; unrelated files are preserved.

actions.label: Save the reviewed note
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Applies only the exact approved local text change through the existing owner.
actions.why: Registers the note in the correct configured location without manual renaming or copying.
actions.where: Review before/after and confirm Save this note.
actions.format: One-use approval. Store upload/publishing is a separate operation; original bytes and existing safety checks are preserved.
actions.failure: A timeout, cleanup uncertainty or partial failure is not success. Do not retry blindly; settle the original operation and follow the recovery guidance.

actions.label: Import a UTF-8 text file
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Uses the operating system file picker to copy selected text into this in-memory draft.
actions.why: Avoids manual copying into project folders or running registration commands.
actions.where: Choose a .txt file on your computer using Select text file. The original file is never moved or modified.
actions.format: Exactly one bounded regular UTF-8 file. After selection, core validation runs immediately. Replacing an existing draft needs confirmation; Save remains separate.
actions.failure: Cancellation, invalid text, a changed/unreadable file or size refusal leaves your existing draft intact. No generic filesystem path is accepted from the UI.

actions.label: Discard this note draft
actions.requiredWhen: When you explicitly choose this local editing action.
actions.what: Releases the selected editor draft after confirmation.
actions.why: Lets you leave without accidentally saving unpublished changes.
actions.where: Choose Discard draft, then confirm; an active original save must settle separately first.
actions.format: A local UI action only. It never deletes saved notes, public locale drafts or signing files.
actions.failure: Cannot discard while an original operation is still unsettled. Resolve its status first; no other task or process is stopped.
